candidate.signal: equal average of sign(ROC40), sign(ROC60), sign(ROC80)
candidate.sizing: 20% annualized realized-volatility target using backward-looking 20-session volatility, capped at 1x gross

chronological_validation.annual_slices: calendar years 2020 through 2026 YTD; HYPE begins when data become usable
chronological_validation.rolling_windows: 365-calendar-day windows stepped every 90 calendar days after candidate warmup; no parameter fitting
success_diagnostics: fraction of annual slices with positive net return
fraction of rolling one-year windows with positive net return

cost_stress.evaluate: full sample and each annual slice

regime_attribution.thresholds: rolling prior-252-observation 33rd and 67th percentiles, minimum 60 prior observations

constraints: DAX cannot affect the primary verdict while its LSE data gate fails.
DSR/PBO are not used as approval gates because the complete historical trial ledger is not reconstructable.
